name: Shirakawa Kagesa
source:
Kagesa is the second oldest among 18 sisters of the Shirakawa family.

She has always [spoiler]had a deep hatred towards Eku since the day Eku ran away, leaving her alone to deal with all hardship in the family.[/spoiler]
translation:
Kagesa is the second oldest among 18 sisters of the Shirakawa family.

She has always [spoiler]had a deep hatred towards Eku since the day Eku ran away, leaving her alone to deal with all hardship in the family.[/spoiler]
